chunks: A number of our companions, from our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Abu al-Abbas al-Kufi, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, all together, from Amr ibn Uthman, from Abdullah al-Dihqan, from Durust, from Abdul Hamid, from Abu Ibrahim (peace be upon him), who said:

Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Marry into the family of so-and-so, for they are chaste, and their women are chaste; and do not marry into the family of so-and-so, for they are adulterous, and their women are adulterous.'

And he said: 'It is inscribed in the Torah: I am Allah, the Killer of the killers, and the Impoverisher of the adulterers. O people! Do not commit adultery, lest your women commit adultery; just as you do, it shall be done with you.'

key_terms.كَمَا تَدِينُ تُدَانُ: As you do, it shall be done with you (reciprocity)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of family character in marriage according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi illustrates the Shia concept of 'spiritual inheritance' within marriage, where the moral integrity (‘iffah) of the husband directly influences the chastity of his wife, a principle rooted in the idea that 'as you are, so are your spouses.' The inclusion of the Torah quote highlights the continuity of this ethical law across Abrahamic traditions, while the chapter title emphasizes the reciprocal nature of sanctity: just as one respects the sacredness of others, one’s own sanctity is preserved or diminished by one’s actions.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Abu Al Abbas Al Kufy, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether, from Amro Bin Usman, from Abdullah Al Dihqan, from Dorost, from Abdul Hameed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said:

‘Rasool-Allah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Get married to the progeny of so and so, for they are restraining (from immoralities), and their womenfolk are restraining, and do not get married to the progeny of so and so, for they are being adulterous, so their womenfolk are being adulterous’.

And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is inscribed in the Torah: “I<sup>azwj</sup> am Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, Killer of the killers, and Impoverisher of the adulterers! O you people! Do not commit adultery, for your womenfolk would commit adultery; just as you do, it shall be done with you’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from abu al-‘Abbas al-Kufiy and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Amr ibn ‘ Uthman from ‘Abd Allah al-Dihqan from Durust from ‘Abd al-Hamid who has said the following:

“The Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘Marry of the family of so and so because they have maintained chastity and so also their women have done and you must not marry of the family of so and so because they have transgressed and so also have their women done.’

He (the Messenger of Allah) has said, ‘It is written in the Torah, ‘I am Allah and I kill the killers and turn the fornicators poor. O people, you must not commit fornication because fornication will be committed with your women. As you recompense likewise you will receive recompense.’”
